entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number to pull up your account?
Sure. It's VF886-015B. It's just not working out.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order from December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. It's just... **hard to use**. The app is incredibly **confusing** and I don't have time to fight with it.
I see. I appreciate you clarifying that.
I read the **user manual** twice. It's no help. I just **expected more** from this thing.
I understand your frustration. Let me just review the return eligibility for your order. Please hold for one moment.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've checked our policy, and since your purchase was 32 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and authorize that return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Finally. I guess that's one thing that's simple enough.

Happy to help. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to the address on file. You'll just need to package the VeloBand in its original box, affix the label, and drop it off with the carrier. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
Perfect. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
